description: Discrete event definitions that can be injected into a running mission timeline to test robustness — failure injection, environment changes, and mission-logic triggers. References failure_modes from failures.json and presets from weather.json by id/name.

trigger_types.time: Fires once simulation clock reaches trigger.time_s.
trigger_types.state_threshold: Fires when a state_vector field crosses trigger.threshold (see states.json for field names).
trigger_types.phase_entry: Fires when the mission simulator enters trigger.phase_name from missions/*.json.

event_library.description: Generic engine-out injection point; set time_s per scenario.
Generic battery fault injection point; set time_s per scenario.
Fires when SoC nears the reserve floor; should push the state machine toward DEGRADED (see states.json).
Fires when fuel nears the reserve floor.
Marker event — useful as an anchor point to inject other events relative to loiter start, e.g. 'engine failure 10 minutes into loiter'.

example_scenarios.description: Robustness test: lose the engine 10 minutes into the loiter phase of surveillance.json and confirm the RL/rule-based controller can still complete descent and landing on battery + reserve margins.
Robustness test: weather shifts to monsoon during the return cruise leg, testing power margin under increased drag/wind.
events: weather_shift_to_monsoon (fire at start of Cruise (Return Transit) phase)
